cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password when Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available Choices for Multiple Saved Credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Pick up new password after password is changed
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable password manager stops save prompts and prefilling
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site results in it no longer autofilling on that site and no longer being listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all stored username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill on sites and nothing listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements R-102 through R-108 have corresponding high-level cases that accurately reflect the stated behaviors without any coverage gaps, blockers, or speculative additions.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box. Expected outcome: The browser discards the password. Scenario types: Normal, Abnormal/Error. R-103: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved. Expected outcome: Those same choices are later available to be presented. Scenario types: Normal. R-104: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: A username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed. Expected outcome: The password manager picks up the new password. Scenario types: Normal. R-105: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Password manager from the preferences panel is disabled. Expected outcome: The browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites. Scenario types: Normal. R-106: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Trigger: A username and password in the password manager are saved. Expected outcome: This information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences. Scenario types: Normal. R-107: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Removal of a username and password for a given site. Expected outcome: It no longer autofills on that site nor is it listed in the password manager. Scenario types: Normal. R-108: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Removal of all username and password information. Expected outcome: It no longer autofills nor is anything listed in the password manager. Scenario types: Normal.
